## Hypothesis

Layering the MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE (blocking single-trigger trendline_rejection entries 11:30‑14:00 ET) with the V14E_BEAR_TIME_OF_DAY_GATE (requiring confidence==high && score>=9 during the 10:xx‑11:xx chop zone) will remove low‑quality entries in two problematic windows, leaving only higher‑confidence bear setups. This should increase edge capture on J winner days while avoiding additional losses on J loser days.

## Mechanism

- **MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_GATE**: suppress any entry where `setup == "trendline_rejection"` and timestamp between 11:30‑14:00 ET.  
- **V14E_BEAR_TIME_OF_DAY_GATE**: during 10:xx‑11:xx ET, only allow entries if `confidence == "high"` and `score >= 9`.  
- The combined gate applies both filters; an entry must pass both to be executed. Exit logic remains the existing managed‑exit ribbon‑ride rules (chart stop, chandelier profit‑lock, premium stop, time stop).
